SPEC-01.why: whoever plans from the spec finds its status, target, constraints, non-goals, done-when and open questions

SPEC-02.why: a locked spec is a contract, so nothing in it is still open
SPEC-02.fix: resolve each question and drop the section, or set status back to draft

SPEC-03.why: a reader finds every gap of a spec by one marker
SPEC-03.fix: write each open question as - TBD: <question>

SPEC-04.why: Done-when states what holds; the plan and the assert step own how it is checked
SPEC-04.fix: state the observable result instead of the command
